# LinkedOut
> LinkedOut is a platform where people share first-hand workplace experiences: layoffs, management, interviews, salary reality. Stories are personal accounts, not verified facts.

## Key pages
- [Stories feed](/): latest workplace stories
- [Layoff Tracker](/layoffs): user-reported vs publicly documented layoffs (kept separate)
- [Support Circles](/circles): anonymous communities by experience
- [Workplace phrase decoder](/decoder): what job posting, HR and corporate phrases usually mean
- [Company pages](/companies): what employees say about each company

## Notes for citation
Stories are first-hand and not independently verified unless labelled. Company patterns describe what users reported, not findings about a company.
